title: Public Safety Data Analytics Platform & Support Services
agency: COURT SERVICES AND OFFENDER SUPERVISION AGENCY.COURT SERVICES AND OFFENDER SUPERVISION AGENCY.COURT SERVICES  OFFENDER SUPV AGCY
description_text:
The Contractor shall provide a public safety data analytics platform and support services.

The solicitation section L.6.3 stipulates the Quoter’s proposed public safety data analytics cloud platform MUST hold a current Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Moderate Authorization at the exact time and date set for submission of quotations. Failure to provide the required evidence or proposing a solution that is currently "In Process", "FedRAMP Ready," or possessing a status lower than Moderate Authorization will result in elimination from the competition.

This is a pre-solicitation notice. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued on June 11, 2026.
